blogs.title: Stop Breaking Your AI Models: Why 'Orthogonal Finetuning' is the Secret to Better Image Generation
blogs.description: This post explains the core problem with current methods for customizing AI art generators like Stable Diffusion: tweaking them often ruins their original creativity. We break down the concept of 'Hyperspherical Energy'—a fancy term for how neurons relate to each other—and explain how Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT) solves this by rotating the model's internal logic without breaking its semantic memory. Perfect for readers who want to understand *why* OFT creates better images than standard fine-tuning.

blogs.title: DreamBooth vs. ControlNet: How OFT Unifies Subject and Structure Control
blogs.description: Explore how Orthogonal Finetuning tackles two of the hardest challenges in AI art: teaching a model a specific subject (like your pet dog) and forcing it to follow strict structural guides (like edge maps or poses). This article compares OFT against popular tools like DreamBooth and ControlNet, highlighting how OFT achieves faster convergence, requires fewer training images, and offers superior stability without slowing down image generation.

blogs.title: Under the Hood: The Math Behind Efficient AI Customization (Without the Jargon)
blogs.description: Dive into the technical mechanics of OFT in plain English. Learn how replacing traditional weight updates with 'orthogonal transformations' allows developers to customize massive models with significantly fewer parameters than competitors like LoRA. We'll visualize how keeping neuron angles intact acts as a safety net, preventing 'model collapse' and ensuring that your customized AI remains versatile and high-quality.
